findings.evidence: Diff lines 171-175: `support s x Q2 hx := h.support s.conj x Q2 hx` etc. — each field is pure precomposition. Line 160: `exact conj_involutive.bijective.sum_comp fun s => mellinMoment f n s Q2` uses only bijectivity. No reindexing lemma exists upstream: grep for `relabel|Equiv|sum_comp` in `code/EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton` hits only this new file; `PDF/Basic.lean` has none. Neighbouring code already works at the generic-index level (`QFT/Factorization/Evolution/MomentSpace.lean:356` `{ι : Type} [Fintype ι]`).
findings.fix: Put the general results next to `Pdf` in `PDF/Basic.lean`: `relabel (σ : κ → ι) (f : Pdf ι) : Pdf κ := fun i => f (σ i)`, `mellinMoment_relabel`, `Assumptions.relabel`, plus `sum_mellinMoment_relabel`/`SumRuleAssumptions.relabel` for a bijective (or `Equiv`) `σ`. Then define `chargeConj f = relabel Species.conj f` and obtain the four lemmas here by instantiation.
findings.issue: `mellinMoment_chargeConj`, `Assumptions.chargeConj`, `sum_mellinMoment_chargeConj` and `SumRuleAssumptions.chargeConj` (lines 137-186) are stated only for `Species.conj`, but their proofs use nothing about charge conjugation: precomposition along any `σ : κ → ι` preserves `Assumptions` and relabels `mellinMoment`, and along any bijection it preserves the species-summed moment and `SumRuleAssumptions`. Stating them only for `conj` fixes them at the wrong level and makes them read as physics of C; the isospin (u↔d) and SU(3) relabellings of roadmap §1.3-§1.4 will need the same four proofs again.

findings.evidence: Diff lines 204-211: the proof only compares `mellinMoment f 0 (.quark i)` with `mellinMoment f 0 (.antiquark i)` via `valenceNumber_chargeConj`, both of which are determined by `f (.quark i)` and `f (.antiquark i)` alone (`valenceNumber` definition, lines 189-191).
findings.fix: State it with the weaker hypothesis, `theorem valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_eq {f : Pdf (Species Flavor)} {i : Flavor} (h : f (.quark i) = f (.antiquark i)) (Q2 : ℝ) : valenceNumber f i Q2 = 0`; the C-invariant case is then `congrFun (congrFun ...)`/`hf ▸ rfl` at the call site in §1.3.
findings.issue: `valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_chargeConj_eq` assumes `chargeConj f = f`, i.e. C-invariance in every species, to conclude vanishing at one flavour `i`; the conclusion only needs the quark and antiquark densities of that flavour to agree.

summary: The four charge-conjugation preservation results use nothing about `Species.conj` beyond its being a map (resp. a bijection), so they are special cases of a missing general relabelling statement about `Pdf ι`; and `valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_chargeConj_eq` assumes global C-invariance where a per-flavour density equality suffices.
